g.text: RESEARCH–BURDEN MISMATCH: ALL STUDIES AND L&MICs-FOCUSED STUDIES
2010–2012 → 2021–2023 research, each compared with its own fixed 2021–2023 DALY reference.
Overall, level-1 and level-2 sections show the same change at increasing detail.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 14.3px; font-family: 'Arial'; text-anchor: start; fill: #252721

g.text: Global DALYs; all eligible disease-coded records

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 14.3px; font-family: 'Arial'; text-anchor: start; fill: #252721

g.text: L&MICs DALYs; records naming a low- or middle-income setting

L&MICs = low- and middle-income countries: low-, lower-middle- and upper-middle-income groups. Mismatch is total variation distance: ½ × Σ |normalised research share − DALY share|. Each cause contributes half its absolute share gap; level-1 rows sum

those contributions, including within-group differences. Each section sums to the same overall total; do not add across sections. Both panels use the same 22 GBD level-2 causes and common row order: level-1 grouping, then summed global DALYs over

2010–2023. Research shares are study–cause links; a multi-disease record contributes to each named cause. Unspecified infections/injuries are excluded from this level-2 analysis; zero counts require no smoothing. Panel A includes records without a

stated country; Panel B requires a low- or middle-income study setting and may include mixed-income multi-country records. Publication-year income defines research settings; burden-year income defines L&MICs DALYs. Global DALYs retain all 204

national locations. Intervals resample studies within year, 1,000 draws; DALY and coding uncertainty are not propagated. Colour shows estimated direction; intervals crossing zero indicate uncertainty. Because the burden references differ, the panel
comparison does not isolate an effect of adding or removing HIC studies.
